headline: US to pay German firm $1.2bn to halt wind projects
summary: The Trump administration is reported to be paying RWE $1.2bn to cancel US wind-project deals.
script: The Trump administration plans to pay German energy company RWE one point two billion dollars to halt US wind projects. The deal adds to a wider push against new wind development.
imageAlt: Wind turbines used to illustrate the US wind-project payout story.
imageAltTwo: A second wind-energy image connected to the project cancellations.
openingText: One point two billion dollars to stop wind
